items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: It was in what was originally the main dining room. But this nightclub was opened in 1933 by the old world's heavyweight champion, Jack Johnson, and he ran it for about a year or so and called it Jack Johnson's.

ctx.x: You also mentioned before when we were talking about the Dunbar, that there was someplace downstairs that had music. Was it a lounge or something?

In the Dunbar, at one time, there was a nightclub there. It was in what was originally the main dining room. But this nightclub was opened in 1933 by the old world's heavyweight champion, Jack Johnson, and he ran it for about a year or so and called it Jack Johnson's.
Was it, what? A regular floor show?^ type entertainment?
